resources.string: Unlocking needs the server, and it cannot be reached right now. Check your connection and try again. This is not a PIN error, and no attempt was used.
Too many requests have come from this network, so the server is pausing them. This is not a problem with your account or your PIN. Try again %1$s.
Unlock the phone first, then enter your Zekke PIN.
The phone locked before unlocking finished. Enter your PIN again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.

The history of your devices that the server returned does not verify from your recovery phrase’s key. Someone may have tampered with it. Do not trust your list of devices, and add no device until this is resolved.
Your account is open, but the phone could not reach the server to finish updating items that use older keys. They will be tried again after another unlock.
Your account is open, but some items could not be updated after a key change. They will be tried again after another unlock.

Remove this phone
Takes this phone off your account’s devices. Coming back needs your recovery phrase.

Remove this phone from your account? It forgets every key it holds, and the server stops accepting it at once. To come back you type your recovery phrase, and nobody can issue you another. Your vault itself is untouched.
